messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: Canary routing errors detected for service checkout-api. Severity: P2. Error rate spike on canary variant + sticky fallback engaged. Paging oncall @sasha :rotating_light:

sasha: seeing it. thanks incident-bot. getting context — which region?

ops-bot: Alert details -> metric: canary_variant_5xx_rate, threshold: 5% -> current: 12%. Affected region: eu-west-1 and fallback region us-west-2 (sticky).

jamal: i'm on my way — oncall takeover inbound (5m). sasha: can you dump the routing policy for checkout-api?

sasha: grabbing config now. snippet:```json
{"service":"checkout-api","route_policy": {"canary": {"variant":"v2-quant","weight":10,"sticky":true}, "fallback": {"policy":"sticky-region","regions":["eu-west-1","us-west-2"],"ttl_secs":3600}}}```

priya: quick note: v2-quant was just onboarded last night with lowered beam size; perf looked ok in test but we saw a mismatch on tokenization for certain customers.

alex: customer impact? any errors returned to clients?

emma_cs: CS floor: some EU customers reporting failed checkouts and 502s. Support ticket volume up ~30% for europe. No major revenue outage yet but spike in retries.

jamal: hypothesis: canary (v2-quant) is returning unexpected response shapes -> runtime rejects -> L7 errors -> sticky fallback to us-west-2 causing cross-region latencies and request skew. sticky fallback TTL is long (1h) so traffic keeps hitting fallback where variant mismatch persists.

sasha: i can flip canary off now (pause rollout) — want me to pause?

jamal: yes pause and remove sticky fallback. Mitigation plan A: pause canary rollouts + change fallback to non-sticky immediate short TTL. Plan B if errors persist: rollback variant to v1-stable and evict kv cache.

priya: to pause: run: `rdctl rollout pause --service checkout-api --target canary`

sasha: running command now.

sasha: `rdctl rollout pause --service checkout-api --target canary` -> accepted by control plane. status: canary weight -> 0 pending drain.

ops-bot: Deploy log: rollout.pause user=sasha ts=2378901252 ok

alex: set fallback to non-sticky TTL 30s: show me the exact patch.

jamal: patch snippet:```yaml
route_policy:
  fallback:
    policy: round_robin
    regions: [eu-west-1, us-west-2]
    sticky: false
    ttl_secs: 30
```

sasha: applying patch via api: `rdctl routing update --service checkout-api --file -` pasted patch and submitted.

ops-bot: Routing update accepted ts=2378901320 by sasha

jamal: can we also drop cached prefix/KV for checkout-api variants in eu-west-1? cached prefixes may still point to v2-quant.

priya: issuing cache invalidation: `rdctl cache invalidate --service checkout-api --scope prefix --regions eu-west-1`

ops-bot: Cache invalidation job queued ts=2378901345 job_id=ci-8921

emma_cs: customers: tickets de-escalated for some after 10m. still seeing intermittent 502s.

jamal: monitoring — error rate trending down from 12% -> 3% in eu-west-1, latencies normalizing. good.

sasha: because canary weight set to 0 but draining, some in-flight requests might still hit v2-quant for ~30s. TTL change should ensure fallback isn't sticky.

alex: what's the plan for the canary variant? do we rollback or re-run with fix?

priya: root cause: tokenization mismatch introduced by quantization step. quick fix would be to rollback to v1-stable for canary bucket and re-run quantize pipeline with correct tokenizer config. I'd prefer rollback for now.

jamal: agree. rollback v2-quant from canary and block it from future rollouts until test pass.

sasha: initiating rollback: `rdctl model rollback --service checkout-api --variant v2-quant --to v1-stable --scope canary`

ops-bot: Model rollback initiated ts=2378901420 by sasha

jamal: keep monitoring for any user-facing errors. notify CS to hold on auto-escalations. Emma, can you update support?

emma_cs: will do. posting update to CS channel and tagging affected tickets: "Mitigation in progress: canary paused and variant rollback; routing fallback changed to non-sticky. We'll update when stable."

sasha: rollback finished; canary variant removed from canary pool. rdctl reports: canary variants: [] weight=0.

ops-bot: Rollback complete ts=2378901482 job_id=rb-7744

jamal: monitoring windows — error rate in eu-west-1 now steady ~0.5%. Latency back to baseline. customer ticket surge receding.

priya: follow-up action items: 1) add automatic test for tokenizer compatibility on quantized builds 2) add guardrail to prevent sticky fallback across regions for new canaries (require manual opt-in) 3) add rollback runbook step to drain weight to zero faster.

alex: i can take 1) and 3). priya take 2)?

priya: on it. i'll open a PR for routing guardrail and add an annotation to canary policy schema: `allow_sticky: explicit_yes_only`.

jamal: handing off to next-shift oncall @jamal -> @sasha for follow-up. sasha you're primary for postmortem.

sasha: acknowledged. will file incident report and timeline. thanks team. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident P2 resolved -> mitigation: paused canary + rollback v2-quant + non-sticky fallback applied. Duration: ~16m. Please file postmortem and tag #incidents for review.

emma_cs: updating tickets: customers notified of fix, will follow up if anything reoccurs.

jamal: closing thread, tagging todos -> `#pm-1789` for postmortem, `#deploy-ops` for guardrail PR review.

sasha: thread closed from my side; leaving notes in incident doc.
